planningNotes.risks:
CIRCULAR IMPORT IS THE #1 TRAP. Both new modules need the StartListenerOptions interface, which stays exported from http-listener.ts. Import it as `import type { StartListenerOptions } from "./http-listener.js";` and NEVER as a value import -- a value import creates a real runtime cycle through the .js bridges and can leave a handler undefined at bind time with no typecheck error. Guard it with `grep -n 'from "./http-listener.js"'` in both new modules and confirm every hit is on an `import type` line.

GUARD ORDER IS THE BEHAVIOR. Preserve exactly: handshake surface (bootstrap, session-pair, request/claim/open) answers BEFORE the JSON/asset split; the retired-approve tombstone answers BEFORE any asset fallback; then JSON_ROUTES membership; then checkHeaders; then the eight per-path POST guards in their current order; then readBoundedBody; then the dispatch chain whose final `else` is serveDocumentDossier. Moving any of these across the extraction boundary changes which code a probe sees.

SERVE-COMMAND BYTES ARE LOAD-BEARING. The registry regex matches `options.deps` and `protocolVersion: protocolVersionOf(request)` literally. Keep the parameter named `options` and the call byte-identical in the new module; renaming it to `deps` or destructuring the argument silently reds a 302-test suite through a regex mismatch, not a type error.

STATIC HOST IS NOT YOURS. aa205 delivers static-asset-host.ts. Verify its line count; if you find yourself editing it, stop -- that is a shared-worktree collision with its owner.

DRILL RESTORE ON UNTRACKED FILES. Two of the drill targets are NEW and therefore untracked, where `git diff` is blind: empty before, during and after. Run `git status --porcelain` on the exact mutated paths FIRST; for every `??` path prove restore by SHA256 equality against an out-of-tree %TEMP% backup suffixed by worker id, in a call SEPARATE from the restore itself. `git diff` is a valid restore proof for TRACKED paths only.

A GREEN DRILL IS A FINDING. If a mutation leaves the suite green, report it -- do not delete the redundant guard to make the mutant bite, and do not weaken the assertion to fit.

BODY-GATE DRILL SUBTLETY. serveAffordances's body gate is a two-term OR (`affordanceRequest === null || affordanceProjectMismatch(...)`). Mutate ONLY the affordanceProjectMismatch term, or a malformed-body case will keep the arm green through the decode term and the drill will prove nothing.

BASELINE IS FOREIGN-RED. The full daemon suite is red under activation/work at merge-base and daemon typecheck may show foreign red in a dirty goal-qualification.test.ts. Attribute by merge-base-vs-HEAD delta intersected with the 10 owned paths, and quote the foreign red verbatim rather than hiding or fixing it.
